integrity: Proof includes exact exhaustiveness bounds, two standalone coefficient and evaluation verifiers, rational point count and source comparisons. Earlier algorithms with prescribed discriminants may have unindexed parameter-level outputs.
scientific_limitations: Only separable degree-three genus-one covers over the seven-element field whose six geometric branch points are all distinct and rational; fixed-target and unmarked counts differ. Enumeration is finite and exact, not an algebraic-closure Hurwitz-fiber enumeration.
title: The six-rational-branch Hurwitz fiber over \(\mathbb F_7\)
